# Agent-Native CLI Toolkit

> Toolkit for building CLI commands that are easy for humans and coding agents to run, inspect, recover from, and extend.

This package is currently named `@side-quest/cli-command-facade`. Its accepted
long-term product identity is `@side-quest/agent-native-cli-toolkit`.

Use this file as a lightweight navigation map. It is not the source of truth.
Root ADRs, package docs, `AGENTS.md`, and `CONTEXT.md` retain their normal repo
ownership.

## Start Here

- [Decision Log](../../docs/plans/2026-05-23-002-agent-native-cli-toolkit-decision-log.md): Temporary planning capture for package identity, ADR links, plans, research, and pending grill questions.
- [Rough PRD](../../docs/plans/2026-05-23-001-feat-agent-native-cli-toolkit-rough-prd.md): Rough product draft for the Agent-Native CLI Toolkit.
